points.K2: 电离辐射与非电离辐射
points.K7: 本底因地而异，职业照射另算
points.K9: 防护从哪里来、为了什么
points.K18: 半值层与十分之一值层
points.K29: 随机性效应与遗传效应
points.S3: 先测剂量率，再定停留时间
points.S4: 用长柄工具，不徒手拿源
points.S5: 巡测仪和剂量计，各有用途
points.S6: 开放源操作：防污染、离开前自检

shots.scene: 欣欣站在黑板前，黑板旁有电离辐射警告标志，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank blackboard next to an ionizing radiation warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们把辐射安全的基础讲透。

shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：原子、盾牌、仪表、细胞
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an atom, a shield, a gauge meter and a cell. No people.
shots.narration: 来源、防护、单位、探测，还有生物效应。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进放射性同位素实验室，好奇地四处张望
shots.prompt_en: The young male student enters a radioisotope lab for the first time and looks around curiously.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚进同位素实验室，满脑子问号。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着墙上的电离辐射警告标志，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at an ionizing radiation warning sign on the wall, with a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 辐射看不见摸不着，到底怎么防？

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰一本空白培训手册
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a blank training booklet.
shots.narration: 小研说：上岗前，先把基础课学好。

shots.scene: 欣欣从手册后面探出头，竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pops up from behind the booklet and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从辐射的历史说起。

shots.scene: 古代工匠在作坊里烧制黄色玻璃马赛克的卡通画
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon of an ancient craftsman workshop making yellow glass mosaic tiles. No people.
shots.narration: 很早以前，人们就用铀给玻璃上色。

shots.scene: 旧式车间里一排桌子和夜光表盘、小毛笔图标
shots.prompt_en: An old-style workshop with rows of tables, glowing watch dials and small paint brushes. No people.
shots.narration: 上世纪二十年代，表盘女工涂夜光漆。

shots.scene: 毛笔靠近嘴巴的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a paint brush tip near a mouth, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 她们用嘴抿笔尖，把镭吃进了体内。

shots.scene: 颌骨和血滴图标旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a jaw bone and a blood drop next to a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 后来出现颌骨坏死、骨病和贫血。

shots.section_title: 电离辐射与非电离辐射
shots.scene: 一条从左到右波长逐渐变长的电磁波谱长条
shots.prompt_en: A long electromagnetic spectrum band with waves getting longer from left to right, with small icons along it. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射按能不能电离物质，分成两大类。
overlay: 电离辐射与非电离辐射

shots.section_title: 电离辐射与非电离辐射
shots.scene: 波谱左端高亮，标出两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The left end of the spectrum band is highlighted with gamma ray and X-ray icons. No people.
shots.narration: γ射线、X射线能电离，是电离辐射。

shots.section_title: 电离辐射与非电离辐射
shots.scene: 波谱右端高亮：太阳、灯泡、微波炉、收音机图标
shots.prompt_en: The right end of the spectrum is highlighted with icons of the sun, a light bulb, a microwave oven and a radio. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外、可见光、微波、无线电，是非电离。

shots.section_title: 电离辐射与非电离辐射
shots.scene: 带电小球直接撞击原子；中性小球先撞出带电粒子
shots.prompt_en: Two diagrams: charged particles hitting atoms directly, and neutral particles first knocking out charged particles. No people.
shots.narration: 带电粒子直接电离，光子和中子间接电离。

shots.section_title: 电离辐射与非电离辐射
shots.scene: 欣欣举起电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 电离辐射有全世界通用的警告标志。

shots.scene: 放大镜、病床、工厂三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a magnifying glass, a hospital bed and a factory. No people.
shots.narration: 电离辐射用处很多。

shots.scene: 化石年代测定、诊断治疗、医疗器械灭菌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fossil with a clock, a medical scanner and sealed sterile medical packs. No people.
shots.narration: 测年代、看病治病、给器械灭菌。

shots.scene: 烟雾报警器和食品包装图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a smoke detector on a ceiling and a packaged food tray. No people.
shots.narration: 烟雾报警器和食品保鲜也会用到。

shots.scene: 原子示意：中间原子核有红蓝小球，外面电子绕行
shots.prompt_en: A simple atom diagram: a nucleus of red and blue balls with electrons orbiting around it. No people.
shots.narration: 原子由质子、中子和电子组成。

shots.scene: 元素符号左下角和左上角各有一个空白小方框
shots.prompt_en: A large blank element symbol card with one small blank box at the lower left and one at the upper left. No people.
shots.narration: 左下写质子数，左上写质量数。

shots.scene: 太阳、大地、食物、房屋四个图标围成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the sun, the ground, food and a house arranged in a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 我们身边一直有天然辐射。

shots.scene: 空白饼图，大部分是绿色，小部分是黄色
shots.prompt_en: A blank pie chart with a large green part and a small yellow part. No people.
shots.narration: 天然来源占大头，人工来源占小头。

shots.scene: 地面冒出淡淡气体飘进地下室的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of faint gas rising from the ground into a basement room. No people.
shots.narration: 天然来源里，从地下冒出的氡最多。

shots.scene: 宇宙射线从天而降、地面向上发出光点
shots.prompt_en: Rays coming down from the sky and glowing dots rising from the ground and building walls. No people.
shots.narration: 宇宙射线和土壤建材，是外照射。

shots.scene: 香蕉、土豆等食物图标旁有一个小原子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a banana and a potato next to a small atom icon. No people.
shots.narration: 食物里的钾四十进入体内，是内照射。

shots.scene: 空白饼图的人工部分被放大，九成是医院图标
shots.prompt_en: The small part of the pie chart is enlarged, and most of it shows a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 人工照射里，大部分来自医疗。

shots.scene: X线机照射人体轮廓；注射器和药瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an X-ray machine shining on a body outline, and a syringe next to a small vial. No people.
shots.narration: 拍片是外照射，用放射性药物是内照射。

shots.scene: 密封小源胶囊图标，旁边绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tiny sealed source capsule with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 密封源不散开，内照射风险小。

shots.scene: 研究、工厂、核设施小图标
shots.prompt_en: Small icons of a research building, a factory and a power plant. No people.
shots.narration: 其余来自科研、工业等非医疗活动。

shots.section_title: 本底因地而异，职业照射另算
shots.scene: 地图上两个城市图标，旁边高矮不同的柱子
shots.prompt_en: A map with two city icons, each with a bar of a different height beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 本底高低，随地区和生活方式而不同。
overlay: 本底因地而异，职业照射另算

shots.section_title: 本底因地而异，职业照射另算
shots.scene: 一根本底柱子上叠加一段橙色的职业照射柱子
shots.prompt_en: A gray background bar with an orange bar stacked on top of it. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射工作带来的职业照射，要另外计算。

shots.section_title: 本底因地而异，职业照射另算
shots.scene: 王老师指着空白剂量限值牌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank board with a limit line drawn on it.
shots.narration: 职业照射有限值，具体以国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 医院大楼图标分出三个科室小门
shots.prompt_en: A hospital building icon with three small department doors. No people.
shots.narration: 医院里，辐射源分布在多个科室。

shots.scene: X线机、CT机、移动X线机的卡通图标
shots.prompt_en: Cartoon icons of an X-ray machine, a CT scanner and a mobile X-ray unit. No people.
shots.narration: 放射科的源是X线设备，关机就没射线。

shots.scene: 注射器、药瓶，病人躺在显像设备上的简笔画
shots.prompt_en: A syringe and a vial, next to a simple outline of a patient lying on an imaging scanner bed.
shots.narration: 核医学把放射性药物注入病人体内。

shots.scene: 病人轮廓周围发出光点
shots.prompt_en: A simple patient outline with glowing dots radiating around it. No people.
shots.narration: 这时，病人本身就是辐射源。

shots.scene: 直线加速器和后装治疗机的卡通图标
shots.prompt_en: Cartoon icons of a large medical linear accelerator and a remote afterloader unit. No people.
shots.narration: 放疗用加速器和近距离治疗设备。

shots.scene: 血袋放进一台带源的辐照仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A blood bag being placed into a shielded irradiator cabinet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 血库还用含源辐照仪处理血液制品。

shots.section_title: 防护从哪里来、为了什么
shots.scene: 老式X线机旁冒出多个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An old-fashioned X-ray machine icon with several yellow warning triangles popping up around it. No people.
shots.narration: 早年放射诊断，发生过很多超照射事故。
overlay: 防护从哪里来、为了什么

shots.section_title: 防护从哪里来、为了什么
shots.scene: 地球图标和一本空白建议书
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon next to a blank recommendations book. No people.
shots.narration: 于是有了国际辐射防护组织和建议。

shots.section_title: 防护从哪里来、为了什么
shots.scene: 两个目标图标：一个盾牌挡住、一个刻度压低
shots.prompt_en: Two goal icons: a shield blocking a threshold line, and a dial turned down to low. No people.
shots.narration: 防护目的：防止确定性效应，限制随机性效应。

shots.scene: 三张卡片：日历、警报灯、房屋
shots.prompt_en: Three cards with icons: a calendar, a flashing alarm light and a house. No people.
shots.narration: 照射情况分三种。

shots.scene: 日历卡片高亮，旁边是按计划运行的设备
shots.prompt_en: The calendar card is highlighted next to a machine running normally. No people.
shots.narration: 按计划用源、开展工作，是计划照射。

shots.scene: 警报灯卡片高亮，旁边洒落的容器图标
shots.prompt_en: The alarm light card is highlighted next to an icon of a tipped-over container. No people.
shots.narration: 事故等意外，需要马上处置，是应急照射。

shots.scene: 房屋卡片高亮，地面冒出淡淡气体
shots.prompt_en: The house card is highlighted with faint gas rising under it. No people.
shots.narration: 决定管控前已经存在的，是现存照射。

shots.scene: 天平一端是爱心、一端是危险标志，爱心更重
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a heart icon on one side and a warning icon on the other; the heart side is heavier. No people.
shots.narration: 正当化：任何照射都要利大于弊。

shots.scene: 刻度旋钮被拧到低档，旁边人数图标减少
shots.prompt_en: A dial knob turned down to low, next to a group of person icons getting smaller. No people.
shots.narration: 最优化：剂量、人数、可能性都尽量低。

shots.scene: 一条红色限值线，柱子都在线下
shots.prompt_en: A red limit line with several bars all below it. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量限值：个人受照不能超过限值。

shots.scene: 工作人员和公众两个人形图标，各有一条线
shots.prompt_en: Two person pictograms, one with a dosimeter badge and one without, each with its own limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 限值只管计划照射，工作人员与公众不同。

shots.scene: 病床图标旁的限值线被虚化
shots.prompt_en: A hospital bed icon next to a faded dotted limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 病人的诊疗照射，不用剂量限值来管。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着写有空白的牌子，牌子上一个向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank sign with a large downward arrow.
shots.narration: 尽量低，既是原则，也是法规要求。

shots.scene: 三个圆形图标：沙漏、拉长的尺子、墙
shots.prompt_en: Three round icons: an hourglass, a long ruler and a thick wall. No people.
shots.narration: 外照射防护，靠三招。

shots.scene: 三个图标下面分别出现向下、向上、向上的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Under the three icons appear arrows: down under the hourglass, up under the ruler, up under the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 时间短、距离远、屏蔽厚，受照就少。

shots.scene: 铅砖和石蜡块两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lead brick and a paraffin wax block side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 屏蔽用什么材料，要看是哪种射线。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着沙漏站在源容器旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds an hourglass beside a shielded source container with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 剂量和停留时间成正比。

shots.scene: 剂量率表盘乘以时钟等于剂量杯
shots.prompt_en: An equation of icons: a dose rate gauge times a clock equals a filled cup. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量等于剂量率乘以时间。

shots.scene: 时钟从一小时变成两小时，杯子从半满变满
shots.prompt_en: A clock goes from one hour to two hours while a cup goes from half full to full. No people.
shots.narration: 待一小时是一份，待两小时就是两份。

shots.scene: 小研在计算器上算，旁边空白计划表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a calculator next to a blank work plan sheet.
shots.narration: 反过来，也能算出最多能待多久。

shots.scene: 阿杰在源附近闲聊的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person chatting idly next to a source container, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 做完就走，不在源旁边逗留。

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在火堆远处，热浪变弱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits a few steps away from a campfire, with heat waves getting weaker toward it.
shots.narration: 离火堆越近越烫，辐射也一样。

shots.scene: 点源向外发出锥形光束，穿过一大一大的方格
shots.prompt_en: A point source sends a cone of rays through grids that get bigger farther away. No people.
shots.narration: 射线向外扩散，越远越稀。

shots.scene: 距离一格、两格、三格，强度一、四分之一、九分之一
shots.prompt_en: Three distance marks with intensity bars shrinking to one quarter and one ninth. No people.
shots.narration: 距离加倍，强度只剩四分之一。

shots.scene: 阿杰后退一步，离开工作台上的源
shots.prompt_en: The young male student steps back from a source container on a lab bench.
shots.narration: 多退一步，效果就很明显。

shots.scene: 铅围裙、铅罐、铅砖三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lead apron, a lead pot and a stack of lead bricks. No people.
shots.narration: 屏蔽能大大减少受照。

shots.scene: 致密方块挡住大部分光点
shots.prompt_en: A dense block stops most glowing dots, only a few pass through. No people.
shots.narration: 越致密的材料，挡得越多。

shots.scene: 设备外壳、源罐、机房厚墙三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shielded machine housing, a shielded source pot and a thick room wall. No people.
shots.narration: 设备、容器、机房墙体都带屏蔽。

shots.scene: 老周帮小研系好铅围裙
shots.prompt_en: The older man helps the female graduate student fasten a lead apron in a lab.
shots.narration: 有的岗位，还要穿戴个人防护用品。

shots.scene: 四种射线从左向右射，依次被纸、塑料、铅、混凝土挡住
shots.prompt_en: Four kinds of rays travel from left to right and are stopped in turn by paper, a plastic sheet, a lead plate and a concrete wall. No people.
shots.narration: 不同射线，穿透力不同。

shots.scene: 一张纸挡住α粒子
shots.prompt_en: A sheet of paper stops alpha particles. No people.
shots.narration: α一张纸就能挡住。

shots.scene: 塑料板挡住β粒子
shots.prompt_en: A clear plastic board stops beta particles. No people.
shots.narration: β用塑料、有机玻璃来挡。

shots.scene: 铅板和混凝土墙挡住γ射线
shots.prompt_en: A lead plate and a concrete wall reduce gamma rays. No people.
shots.narration: γ和X射线，用铅或混凝土。

shots.scene: 石蜡块和混凝土挡住中子
shots.prompt_en: Paraffin wax blocks and a concrete wall slow down neutrons. No people.
shots.narration: 中子要用石蜡、混凝土等含氢多的材料。

shots.scene: X线管头外壳剖面，内有屏蔽层
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of an X-ray tube housing showing an inner shielding layer. No people.
shots.narration: 含源设备必须自带合格屏蔽。

shots.scene: 老李用仪表检测新设备外壳
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a new machine housing with a handheld survey meter.
shots.narration: 新设备到货，要由专业人员验收检测。

shots.scene: 机房三维图，带迷路和厚墙
shots.prompt_en: A 3D cutaway of a treatment room with a maze entrance and thick walls. No people.
shots.narration: 机房屏蔽，建之前设计，装完后验证。

shots.scene: 空白审批单和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank approval form with a stamp icon and a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有的要经审批，还要定期检测。

shots.section_title: 半值层与十分之一值层
shots.scene: 射线穿过一层材料，强度柱子减半
shots.prompt_en: Rays pass through one layer of material and the intensity bar drops to half. No people.
shots.narration: 让强度减半的厚度，叫半值层。
overlay: 半值层与十分之一值层

shots.section_title: 半值层与十分之一值层
shots.scene: 一层、两层、三层，柱子一半、四分之一、八分之一
shots.prompt_en: Bars after one, two and three layers drop to one half, one quarter and one eighth. No people.
shots.narration: 每多一层，再减一半。

shots.section_title: 半值层与十分之一值层
shots.scene: 厚一些的板，柱子降到十分之一
shots.prompt_en: A thicker slab cuts the intensity bar down to one tenth. No people.
shots.narration: 降到十分之一的厚度，叫十分之一值层。

shots.section_title: 半值层与十分之一值层
shots.scene: 设计图上厚度箭头被加长
shots.prompt_en: A blank wall design drawing where the thickness arrow is extended further. No people.
shots.narration: 屏蔽设计按最高能量算，宁厚勿薄。

shots.scene: 源→空气→物体→人体→器官的箭头链
shots.prompt_en: An arrow chain of icons: a source, air, a block, a body outline and organs. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射的量，从源一路算到人体。

shots.scene: 原子一个个闪光衰变，旁边计时器
shots.prompt_en: Atoms flash one by one as they decay, next to a stopwatch. No people.
shots.narration: 活度是每秒衰变的次数。

shots.scene: 两个单位徽章图标
shots.prompt_en: Two unit badge icons side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 单位是贝可，旧单位是居里。

shots.scene: 一堆小球每过一段时间少一半
shots.prompt_en: A pile of balls shrinks to half, then to a quarter, as a clock turns. No people.
shots.narration: 活度减半所需时间，叫半衰期。

shots.scene: 一排时钟，从秒针到日历到地球年代
shots.prompt_en: A row of clocks from a stopwatch to a calendar to a globe with years. No people.
shots.narration: 不同核素，半衰期从不到一秒到几十亿年。

shots.scene: X线管射向一团空气，空气里出现正负小离子
shots.prompt_en: An X-ray tube shines into a block of air, and small plus and minus ions appear in the air. No people.
shots.narration: 照射量，看X和γ在空气里电离多少。

shots.scene: 三个打叉小图标：带电粒子、人体、高能
shots.prompt_en: Three crossed-out small icons: a charged particle, a body outline and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 只用于X和γ，只用于空气。

shots.scene: 管电压旋钮调高，光点变多
shots.prompt_en: A voltage knob on a blank X-ray control panel turned up, with more rays coming out. No people.
shots.narration: 管电压越高、曝光量越大，照射量越大。

shots.scene: X线管远离测量点，光点变稀
shots.prompt_en: An X-ray tube moves farther from a measuring point and the rays get sparse. No people.
shots.narration: 离X线管越远，照射量越小。

shots.scene: 射线照进任意物块，物块发热发光
shots.prompt_en: Rays enter different blocks of material, which glow faintly. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收剂量，适用于任何物质和射线。

shots.scene: 一千克方块加一焦耳能量图标
shots.prompt_en: A one-kilogram block with an energy icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 每千克吸收一焦耳，就是一戈瑞。

shots.scene: 同样能量下，α造成更大损伤
shots.prompt_en: Two tissue icons with the same amount of energy; the alpha side shows much bigger damage marks. No people.
shots.narration: 同样吸收剂量，射线种类不同，伤害不同。

shots.scene: 吸收剂量乘以权重因子，等于当量剂量
shots.prompt_en: An icon equation: absorbed dose times a weighting factor badge equals equivalent dose. No people.
shots.narration: 乘上辐射权重因子，得到当量剂量。

shots.scene: 光子、电子、质子、α四个图标，下面是高低不同的柱子
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a photon, an electron, a proton and an alpha particle with bars of increasing height below. No people.
shots.narration: 光子电子最小，质子稍大，α最大。

shots.scene: 中子图标旁一条随能量起伏的曲线
shots.prompt_en: A neutron icon next to a curve that rises and falls with energy. No people.
shots.narration: 中子的权重因子，随能量变化。

shots.scene: 带剂量计的人形和普通人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram wearing a dosimeter badge and a plain person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 可能受到高于本底照射的，是辐射工作人员。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生上培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 辐射工作人员必须接受辐射安全培训。

shots.scene: 小研胸前戴着空白剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a blank personal dosimeter badge on her chest.
shots.narration: 还要佩戴个人剂量计，监测受照剂量。

shots.scene: 其他人员人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A group of plain person pictograms in a hallway. No people.
shots.narration: 其他人都属于公众，限值要求更严。

shots.scene: 眼睛、鼻子、舌头、耳朵图标都打上问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eye, a nose, a tongue and an ear, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射无色无味无声，人感觉不到。

shots.scene: 电离、化学、发热、闪光、加热发光五个小图标
shots.prompt_en: Five small icons: ion pairs, a test tube with bubbles, a thermometer, a light flash and a heated crystal glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器靠电离、闪光等效应发现辐射。

shots.scene: 电离室、正比计数器、盖革计数器的卡通外形
shots.prompt_en: Cartoon icons of three gas-filled detectors of different shapes. No people.
shots.narration: 常见气体探测器有三类。

shots.scene: 闪烁晶体和半导体芯片图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a scintillation crystal and a semiconductor chip detector. No people.
shots.narration: 还有闪烁探测器和半导体探测器。

shots.scene: 源发出十个光点，探测器接住一个
shots.prompt_en: A source sends out ten dots and a detector catches one of them. No people.
shots.narration: 探测效率，是测到的数除以发出的数。

shots.scene: 指环剂量计、胸卡剂量计、笔式、电子剂量计四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ring dosimeter, a badge dosimeter, a pen dosimeter and a small electronic dosimeter. No people.
shots.narration: 个人剂量计，记录一段时间内受的剂量。

shots.scene: 小研对比几种剂量计，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares several blank dosimeters on a table with a question mark above.
shots.narration: 选哪种，看用途和射线。

shots.scene: 手指戴指环剂量计在操作台前工作
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand wearing a ring dosimeter works behind a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 手部近距离操作，可加戴指环剂量计。

shots.scene: X线控制台上两个旋钮，像天平两端
shots.prompt_en: Two knobs on a blank X-ray control panel shown like the two pans of a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 医疗照射同样要优化。

shots.scene: 影像太黑、太白、刚好三张空白片
shots.prompt_en: Three blank image panels: one too dark, one too white and one just right with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 参数要平衡，既清楚，又不多照。

shots.scene: 提高一个旋钮、降低另一个，剂量杯变少
shots.prompt_en: One knob turned up and the other turned down, while a dose cup gets smaller. No people.
shots.narration: 图像够用时，调参数可以降低病人剂量。

shots.scene: 箭头链：原子→分子→细胞→组织→器官→人体
shots.prompt_en: An arrow chain of icons: atom, molecule, cell, tissue, organ, whole body. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射先电离原子，再一步步影响全身。

shots.scene: 射线打到DNA双螺旋上
shots.prompt_en: A ray hits a DNA double helix inside a cell nucleus. No people.
shots.narration: 最关键的目标，是细胞里的DNA。

shots.scene: 三条箭头：修复（绿勾）、死亡、异常分裂
shots.prompt_en: Three arrows from a damaged DNA icon: repaired with a green check, a dead cell, and a cell dividing out of control. No people.
shots.narration: 损伤后，多数能修复，也可能死亡或癌变。

shots.scene: 四条DNA，损伤从轻到重，最重的标α
shots.prompt_en: Four DNA strands with damage from mild to severe; the most severe one has an alpha label. No people.
shots.narration: α造成的DNA损伤最严重。

shots.scene: 染色体断裂、成环的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of chromosomes with breaks and ring shapes. No people.
shots.narration: 染色体也会断裂、错接，形成畸变。

shots.scene: 两类畸变：一个细胞消失，一个传给子代细胞
shots.prompt_en: Two types of aberrations: one leads to cell death, the other is passed on to daughter cells. No people.
shots.narration: 有的使细胞死亡，有的能长期保留。

shots.scene: 一张空白术语卡片墙
shots.prompt_en: A wall of blank vocabulary cards with small icons. No people.
shots.narration: 先认识几个风险术语。

shots.scene: 大杯一次倒完；小杯慢慢滴
shots.prompt_en: A big cup poured out at once next to a small cup dripping slowly over a long time. No people.
shots.narration: 短时间大剂量是急性，长期小剂量是慢性。

shots.scene: 流程图：细胞受损→修复/死亡/变异
shots.prompt_en: A flowchart: a damaged cell leads to repair, cell death or a modified cell. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞大量死亡，导致确定性效应。

shots.scene: 变异细胞分向体细胞和生殖细胞两个方向
shots.prompt_en: A modified cell branching to a body cell icon and a germ cell icon. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞变异，可能致癌或遗传，是随机性效应。

shots.scene: S形曲线，低剂量段平坦，过了阈值陡升
shots.prompt_en: An S-shaped curve that stays flat at low dose and rises sharply after a threshold mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确定性效应有阈值，超过才会出现。

shots.scene: 剂量越大，伤害图标越重
shots.prompt_en: A row of damage icons getting more severe as a dose arrow increases. No people.
shots.narration: 超过阈值后，剂量越大越严重。

shots.scene: 皮肤发红、脱发、眼睛混浊、血滴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of reddened skin, hair loss, a cloudy eye lens and a blood drop. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤红斑、脱发、白内障、血液异常。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标旁有透视设备图标
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon next to a fluoroscopy machine icon. No people.
shots.narration: 长期做透视的人，要特别保护眼晶状体。

shots.scene: 几个人形高矮不同的阈值线
shots.prompt_en: Several person pictograms each with a threshold line at a different height. No people.
shots.narration: 阈值因人而异，不能拿来冒险。

shots.scene: 急救箱和病床图标旁警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A first aid kit and a hospital bed icon with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 很高剂量会引起急性放射病。

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与遗传效应
shots.scene: 一排骰子，剂量越大，中奖的骰子越多
shots.prompt_en: Rows of dice; as a dose arrow grows, more dice show a red face. No people.
shots.narration: 随机性效应没有阈值，看的是概率。
overlay: 随机性效应与遗传效应

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与遗传效应
shots.scene: 日历翻过多年，细胞图标变色
shots.prompt_en: A calendar flipping through many years next to a cell icon changing color. No people.
shots.narration: 通常多年后才出现，如癌症和白血病。

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与遗传效应
shots.scene: 成人图标和孩子图标，中间一条DNA
shots.prompt_en: An adult pictogram and a child pictogram connected by a DNA strand. No people.
shots.narration: 受照者本人的是躯体效应，传给子女是遗传效应。

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与遗传效应
shots.scene: 实验小鼠图标旁有问号和箭头指向人
shots.prompt_en: A lab mouse icon with an arrow pointing to a person pictogram and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 人类遗传效应，主要从动物数据推断。

shots.scene: 五张卡片：身体部位、敏感性、射线种类、总剂量、剂量率
shots.prompt_en: Five cards with icons: a body part, a cell, a ray type, a cup and a speedometer. No people.
shots.narration: 效应大小，取决于这些因素。

shots.scene: 从红到绿的箭头，上端血细胞，下端骨头
shots.prompt_en: A vertical arrow from red at the top to green at the bottom, with blood cell icons at the top and bone icons at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 淋巴、造血、生殖细胞最敏感。

shots.scene: 神经、肌肉、骨骼图标排在绿色一端
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a nerve, a muscle and a bone at the green end of the arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 神经、肌肉、骨骼相对不敏感。

shots.scene: 孕妇图标和儿童图标旁有爱心
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pregnant person and a child with a heart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 分裂旺盛的组织，更需要保护。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在紫外灯、激光、微波三个警示标志前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of an ultraviolet warning sign, a laser warning sign and a microwave non-ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 非电离辐射虽不电离，也会伤人。

shots.scene: 紫外灯、激光器、微波设备三个图标，各有一副护具
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a UV lamp with UV goggles, a laser with laser safety goggles, and a microwave device with a shielding door. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外、激光、射频，各按专门规定防护。

shots.scene: 两本空白规程，一本有电离辐射标志，一本有激光标志
shots.prompt_en: Two blank rule books, one with an ionizing radiation warning sign on the cover and one with a laser warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 别拿电离辐射的办法套用。

shots.scene: 欣欣对紧张的阿杰摆摆手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot calmly waves a paw at the nervous young male student.
shots.narration: 本底辐射一直都在，不必恐慌。

shots.scene: 地下室开窗通风，气体飘走
shots.prompt_en: A basement room with an open window and a fan; faint gas drifts out. No people.
shots.narration: 地下室、密闭房间，多通风能降低氡。

shots.scene: 本底柱子旁一段被高亮的额外柱子
shots.prompt_en: A background bar next to a highlighted extra bar. No people.
shots.narration: 工作带来的额外照射，才是要管住的。

shots.section_title: 先测剂量率，再定停留时间
shots.scene: 老李打开巡测仪，对着源容器测量
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns on a handheld survey meter and measures near a shielded source container.
shots.narration: 公式只是估算，先用仪器实测剂量率。
overlay: 先测剂量率，再定停留时间

shots.section_title: 先测剂量率，再定停留时间
shots.scene: 小研在空白工作计划上写下时间分段
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes time blocks on a blank work plan sheet.
shots.narration: 再按测得的数，安排操作时间和人员。

shots.section_title: 先测剂量率，再定停留时间
shots.scene: 预演图标：空手在台前模拟动作
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a practice run: hands rehearsing steps at an empty bench without a source. No people.
shots.narration: 复杂操作，先不带源练熟。

shots.section_title: 用长柄工具，不徒手拿源
shots.scene: 长柄镊子夹起小源容器
shots.prompt_en: Long-handled tongs pick up a small source vial behind a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 取放放射源，用长柄镊子或工具。
overlay: 用长柄工具，不徒手拿源

shots.section_title: 用长柄工具，不徒手拿源
shots.scene: 手直接去拿源的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand reaching for a radioactive source, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能徒手拿，手离源越近受照越多。

shots.section_title: 用长柄工具，不徒手拿源
shots.scene: 源放回铅罐，盖好盖子
shots.prompt_en: A source vial being placed back into a lead pot and the lid closed. No people.
shots.narration: 用完立刻放回屏蔽容器。

shots.section_title: 巡测仪和剂量计，各有用途
shots.scene: 巡测仪和个人剂量计并排
shots.prompt_en: A handheld survey meter and a personal dosimeter badge side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 巡测仪和个人剂量计，作用不同。
overlay: 巡测仪和剂量计，各有用途

shots.section_title: 巡测仪和剂量计，各有用途
shots.scene: 巡测仪表针实时摆动
shots.prompt_en: The needle of a survey meter swings in real time near a source container. No people.
shots.narration: 巡测仪实时看现场剂量率。

shots.section_title: 巡测仪和剂量计，各有用途
shots.scene: 剂量计放进信封，寄往检测机构
shots.prompt_en: A dosimeter badge goes into an envelope with an arrow to a lab building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量计记累计剂量，定期送检。

shots.section_title: 巡测仪和剂量计，各有用途
shots.scene: 测污染的表面探头贴近手套
shots.prompt_en: A surface contamination probe held close to a gloved hand. No people.
shots.narration: 查污染，要用表面污染仪。

shots.section_title: 开放源操作：防污染、离开前自检
shots.scene: 小研在铺吸水纸的托盘里、屏蔽后操作，穿实验服戴手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and gloves works inside an absorbent-lined tray behind a shield.
shots.narration: 操作开放源，在托盘里垫好吸水纸。
overlay: 开放源操作：防污染、离开前自检

shots.section_title: 开放源操作：防污染、离开前自检
shots.scene: 水杯、饼干、口红图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cup, a biscuit and a lipstick, all crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 工作区不吃不喝，不化妆。

shots.section_title: 开放源操作：防污染、离开前自检
shots.scene: 用嘴吸移液管的图标被红叉划掉；旁边移液器打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of mouth pipetting crossed out with a red X, next to a pipette aid with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不用嘴吸移液管。

shots.section_title: 开放源操作：防污染、离开前自检
shots.scene: 小研脱手套后，用表面污染仪测手和鞋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks her hands and shoes with a surface contamination meter after removing gloves.
shots.narration: 离开前，测一测手、衣服和鞋。

shots.scene: 手背上有一小块污染标记，水龙头打开
shots.prompt_en: A hand with a small contamination mark under a running faucet. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤沾污，立即用温水和肥皂冲洗。

shots.scene: 硬刷子刷皮肤的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hard brush scrubbing skin, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要用力刷，别把皮肤擦破。

shots.scene: 小研打电话报告，旁边空白记录单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls on a phone next to a blank record form.
shots.narration: 冲洗后复测，并报告负责人。

shots.scene: 老李拿巡测仪沿实验室巡测，记在空白表格上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks around a radioisotope lab with a survey meter and records on a blank form.
shots.narration: 工作场所要定期监测辐射水平。

shots.scene: 王老师翻阅空白年度报告
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank annual report binder.
shots.narration: 每年评估辐射安全状况，发现问题就整改。

shots.scene: 墙面裂缝和屏蔽门缝图标，旁边扳手
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crack in a shielding wall and a gap at a shielded door, next to a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 屏蔽有破损，及时报告维修。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现波谱、原子、医院图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a spectrum band, an atom and a hospital.
shots.narration: 认识电离辐射的来源和用途。

shots.scene: 天平、旋钮、限值线三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a balance scale, a dial turned down and a limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 正当化、最优化、剂量限值。

shots.scene: 沙漏、尺子、墙三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an hourglass, a ruler and a wall, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 时间短、距离远、屏蔽对。

shots.scene: 单位徽章和仪表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of unit badges and a survey meter. No people.
shots.narration: 分清活度、剂量，靠仪器说话。

shots.scene: DNA、S形曲线、骰子三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a DNA strand, an S-shaped curve and dice. No people.
shots.narration: 确定性效应有阈值，随机性效应看概率。

shots.scene: 托盘、长柄镊子、表面污染仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an absorbent tray, long-handled tongs and a surface contamination meter. No people.
shots.narration: 用工具、防污染、离开前自检。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye at the door of a tidy radioisotope lab.
shots.narration: 懂原理，守规矩，辐射工作才安全！
